# Part LXXXIII — Single-console conversion (Phase 6 / Phase 7)

Session 68, 2026-10-22. The process engineer signed off §LXXXII.3's two display-only notes as built
(no B-113), had sessions 62 to 67 committed (`15e66c2`), and decided to convert the simulator from
a multi-station application to a **single-console** one (`project.md` decision 149, superseding
decisions 72, 124 and 125). The transport carries no process equation; what changed is who may send
a command and how the console reaches the engine. Nothing in the physics moved.

## LXXXIII.1 What was removed, and what was kept

Removed:

* `run.py`'s `server` and `station` modes, `--host`, `--role`, `--token` and ``UREASIM_TOKEN``
  (and from `launch.bat` and `README.md`). `python run.py` starts the engine on `127.0.0.1` and the
  console attached to it; `--port`, `--station` (the audit line's name) and `--verbose` remain.
* `net/protocol.py`: ``Role`` and its four roles, ``EXERCISE_ROLES``, ``LOCAL_ONLY_ROLES``,
  ``runs_the_exercise``, ``INSTRUCTOR_ONLY_COMMANDS`` and ``is_authorised`` (the ``_fault``
  suffix gate with them), the ``assignment`` and ``roster`` kinds, and the ``hello`` token. `hello`
  is ``{station, protocol}``, `welcome` ``{station, protocol, engine}``, `event` ``{station, cmd,
  text}``; ``PROTOCOL_VERSION`` is 2, so a console of the multi-station protocol is refused with
  the reason rather than misread.
* `net/server.py`: the token check (``_login_refusal``), the role check, the superuser's loopback
  grant, unit assignment (``assign``, ``_within_assignment``), the roster and its broadcast, and
  the instructor-only exercise list.
* `data/tags.py` (command-to-section attribution), whose only consumers were the assignment and
  the instructor's section boxes; ``assign`` from the engine's ``SIMULATOR_COMMANDS``.
* `hmi/bridge.py`: the role and token arguments and the ``role_changed``,
  ``assignment_changed`` and ``roster_changed`` signals. `hmi/main_window.py`: the role badge and
  the assignment readout; the Instructor menu is always shown. `hmi/instructor/panel.py`: the
  station roster and the section assignment.

Kept: the strict UI-to-physics boundary (`EngineBridge` over a loopback `QTcpSocket`, the engine
host's physics thread, no Qt at or below `ureasim/net`), length-prefixed JSON framing, snapshot
back-pressure (§XIII.3), the catch-up snapshot and status on `hello`, the 5 s staleness watchdog and
the blanked screen on a lost link (§XIII.4), history backfill, the exercise list, the audit echo,
and the engine's process refusals with their reasons (§XIII.1). A refusal of the console's `hello`
is still shown and not retried (register row 291's fix).

## LXXXIII.2 The console's one guard

With the token gone, nothing but the network stands between a connection and the plant, so the
server binds `127.0.0.1` (``DEFAULT_HOST``) and refuses a `hello` from any address that is not the
engine's own machine — a loopback address, IPv4 loopback mapped into IPv6 included — with the
reason. A console that reconnects can hold two connections for a moment; the server serves every
connection that has said `hello`, so the new one is never refused for its own stale link.

## LXXXIII.3 The CO2 demand on the instructor's panel

`co2_set`, the battery-limit CO2 rate asked of 320K002 (decision 73), was role-gated in
`net/protocol.py` and sent by no console control. It is now the instructor's panel's **Boundary**
group: a demand in t/h from 0 to V1's hard ceiling of 120 % of the design feed (54.618 t/h ×
``CO2_DEMAND_MAX_FRAC`` = 1.20, from V1's ``frontend/co2_compressor.js`` ``MIN`` and ``MAX``; the
spin box holds three decimals, its top 65.542), sent as ``{"type": "co2_set", "value": v}`` and
answered by the engine (refused while trip 22.2 or 21.2's flag is latched, as before), with the
packet's ``CO2_FEED.raw_th`` shown beside it. The process screens still send it from no element.

## LXXXIII.4 Tests

* Deleted: `tests/net/test_server_login.py`, `tests/net/test_server_superuser.py`,
  `tests/data/test_tags.py`.
* Rewritten for the single console: `tests/net/test_protocol.py` (the handshake carries no role,
  token or sections; version 2), `tests/net/test_server.py` (every command the engine's to answer,
  the simulator controls and the ``_fault`` form included; a remote peer refused; an overlapping
  reconnect served), `tests/net/test_engine_host.py`, `tests/hmi/test_bridge.py` (welcomed on a
  real socket; a refused `hello` shown and not retried), `tests/hmi/test_main_window.py`,
  `tests/hmi/instructor/test_panel.py` (the CO2 demand and its range) and `tests/test_run.py` (the
  multi-station options gone).
* `tests/units/synthesis/test_co2_compressor.py`: V1's hand station sends ``co2_set``; the port's
  screens send it from no element and only the instructor's panel does, both ways.
* A smoke run through `run.py`'s own functions, offscreen: the console welcomed, ``ENGINE RUNNING —
  SLOW``, the panel's CO2 demand of 60.08 t/h and FREEZE acknowledged, the audit line fed, the
  packet's demand 60.08.

## LXXXIV.4 LV-324501A / B and the leg's seal

Flowserve's 0310 angle valves (DN 100, Kvs 100, equal percentage, rangeability 50:1 printed): A to
the granulation header, fail closed, quick closing under 3 s; B the recycle to 323D002, fail open.
The sheets size the melt on SG 0.751, viscosity 2.219 cP and vapour pressure 0.130 bar a; the loop
summary L 324501 and PFD 402 put it at 1221 kg/m3. A trim passes m = Kv sqrt(rho dP), so each
printed Kv is taken to the melt by sqrt(0.751 . 1221): A's design stroke, where its rated Kv passes
the design drain on that corrected normal case, is 75.35 % (V1's span law: 75 %); B, shut at
design, is anchored on its full stroke on its own corrected normal case, 251.5 t/h over
6.9 → 1.8 bar a. V1's span law carries no pressure, and the trims keep that form:

    m_402 = m_des . phi_A(h) / phi_A(h_des)          (A routed)
    m_402 = m_B,full . phi_B(h)                       (B routed, PIC-335201 above 3.8 bar g)

`SecondEvaporator.vendor_drain` switches them and ``lic_324501(vendor=)`` seeds LIC-324501 on the
stroke; the lost seal's air (decision 143) is LV-324501A's trim ratio on the same curve. With the
335 header backing up, B passes 95.7 t/h at the stroke where V1's law passed the design drain; on a
feed-pump trip LIC-324501 closes the drain at 638 s with the level at 21.6 % and the melt holds
1496 kg (V1's line: 15 %, 1041 kg).

## LXXXV.3 How the moves were made

* **Verbatim.** Each split was cut by a script on line ranges it asserted first, and checked by
  comparing the lines of the original file with those of the files that replaced it: the only
  lines not carried over are the section banners the new modules' docstrings stand in for and the
  import lines that moved with their users.
* **Re-exported, acyclic.** The module a name left imports it back and lists it in its
  ``__all__`` (`scrubber` gained an ``__all__``, its public surface with the re-exports), so no
  caller and no test changed an import. Each new module imports only what lies below it — the
  sizing records below the catalogues, the payload helpers below the handlers, the stage-1 basis
  below the section — so importing either side first works.
* **Into the tag's module where one existed.** Stage 1 went into `unit_323c003`, which held
  323C003's relief only and now opens with the column's design basis; the vacuum train's ratings
  went into `unit_324_train`, which had imported them from `unit_324`. The first cut of stage 1
  was written over `unit_323c003.py` itself; the file was restored from git before any test ran on
  it, and the stage merged into it instead (`CLAUDE.md` §1 rule 1 now says to look first).
* **Private helpers keep their names.** `command_payload`'s ``_Refused``, ``_num``, ``_want``,
  ``_clamp``, ``_needs``, ``_trip``, ``_trip_name`` and `carbamate_solid`'s ``_less_deposit``,
  ``_supersaturation``, ``_deposit_at`` are imported by the modules that call them; no test patches
  a moved name (searched), so every call resolves to the same function as before.
* **Two comments** that pointed across the cut were reworded: Metso's steam cases carry a unit
  density "as for Flowserve's motive valves" (it read "as for the motive valves above"), and each
  module that lost names says where they went.
* **The node stores** are keyed on `parameters`, `standard_state`, `activity`, `speciation`,
  `henry`, `iapws` and the node functions of `ammonia_backpressure`; none was touched, so the
  stores stay valid and were not rebuilt.

## LXXXVIII.4 TIC-328008 and FFIC-335406 on their faceplates (B-116, decision 160)

**TIC-328008** (`20261024_033802.jpg`): gain 1.00 on its inferential's 0-100 wt% water, TI 60 s, TD
and TF 0, set point 40.0 wt%, DZ 2 % (no deadband in the model, decision 93). The model carries 737's
water in mol%; the gain goes onto it by the local slope at the PFD's composition (737: 12.32 mol% CO2,
46.21 H2O, 41.47 NH3), the water moving against the rest of the gas:

    dw/dy = M_H2O . M_rest / M_737^2 = 18.0152 x 23.2097 / 20.8093^2 = 0.96559
    Kc = 1.00 . (8.0 m3/h x 1095 kg/m3) / 100 wt% x 0.96559 = 84.586 kg/h of reflux per mol%

its output on FIC-328404's 0-8.0 m3/h span in mass (decision 21). The design's 46.21 mol% is 40.01
wt%, the faceplate's set point. On the drum alone a set-point step to 48 mol% settles on both
tunings, the row's more slowly — successive peaks 1.44, 1.25, 1.08 mol%, a decay ratio of 0.87 a
22-minute period, against 0.61 on V1's 240 kg/h per mol% and 110 s; ten minutes into the step 737
carries 48.9513 mol% on the row and 47.9945 on V1's (`test_reflux_drum_decided_equivalence.py::
test_tic_328008_on_its_faceplate_decided_divergence`). PIC-328202's port side moves to 3.6609 bar a
(3.6610 before). V1's tuning stays on the reflux-drum and synthesis harnesses.

**FFIC-335406** (`20261024_034014.jpg`, "UF/US RATIO CTRL."): a ratio station, OUT = RAT . MV + BIAS
— MV the urea solution's flow, 89.9 t/h that night, RAT 0.0032, OUT 0.29 t/h — its limits RAT 0.0000
to 0.0080, OUT 0.00 to 0.80 t/h, BIAS 0.0. Built on `control.ratio.RatioStation`:

    SP_405 = clamp(RAT . m_402 / 1000, 0, 0.80)   [t/h],      RAT within [0, 0.0080]

its ratio tracking the achieved one while FIC-335405 is out of cascade, its output at OUT L while
LV-324501B or no melt stops the pumps. The design seed is the PFD's ratio, 694 / 85 405 = 0.0081260,
which closes the design at 617.0722 kg/h to the bit and stands 1.6 % above RAT H; an operator's ratio
and a mode transfer are held to RAT H (signed off as built, session 74). On a 20 % ramp of the melt

# Part LXXXIX — The load range 70-115 %: an operating study on the committed engine (Phase 7)

Sessions 75 and 76, 2026-10-29 and 30. A study, not a port: no relation, constant, test or document
datum changed. The committed engine — the last turnaround's 2,950-tube 322E001 and the plugged tubes
re-anchored on the bundles in service (decisions 154, 155, 157) — was driven headless at the fixed
0.1 s step to map its steady operating envelope from 70 to 115 % load for two objectives, the
reactor's per-pass conversion and the battery-limit steam per tonne of urea, each point to be held
one hour. The deliverable is `D:\Work\Urea_Plant_Load_Optimization_70_to_115.xlsx`. Session 75's
earlier request (the set points on three bases) is superseded; its last runs died unfinished.

## LXXXIX.1 Method

A scratch runner (the session's scratchpad, not the tree) ramps the instructor's CO2 demand from
the design seed at 0.25 to 0.5 %/min and moves the operator's handles only through
`engine.command.apply_command`: HIC-322605 on LT-322504's 80 % (20.0 m), HIC-322602 on 322E003's 50 %
(the spindle solved on 322F001's own map at the live motive), PIC-329204 on TT-322004, MASTER-329207
on TT-322005 (4.21 to 6.2 bar a), and, where stated, HIC-323605 on 323F010's level; FFIC-321404 at
its design 2.023. After a settle of two to seven hours it holds 3 600 s with the level trims still
acting and every other handle frozen, and saves exercise snapshots at the hold's start and end so
candidates branch from a settled plant. The hold is judged on every level the results and the packet
publish — least-squares drift under 0.5 %/h and net change under 0.5 %, none above 100 % or drained
to its heel — and on relief, overflow, lost suction, held-back liquor, seals, mushy flow, 322F001's
stall, HV-322604's carbamate deposition, trips and flags.

The licensor's operating windows (Operating Manual Part III, UD-VT-G00-DC-0003 section 5.2, read from
the scan by OCR and checked on the page): reactor-outlet N/C 2.90-3.10, TT-322005 180-183 C, synthesis
136-143 bar, stripper steam 19.6 bar at 100 % and never above 23 bar, TT-322004 162-176 C (+5 K), HP
scrubber cooling water in about 80 C, overflow about 165 C, off-gas 110-120 C; section 2.6.3, read
visually: name-plate HP steam 66.9 t/h at 107.8 bar a and 505 C including the CO2 turbine. The PFD's
901: 60 848 kg/h at 1750 MTPD and 66 799 kg/h at 1925 MTPD, 902 at 19.7 bar a in both. The plant's own
practice: `References/DCS Trends/Book2.xlsx` (July to September 2023) holds 755 samples at 90-95 %
load and 4 131 at 110-112 %; its medians are in `handoff.md` B-118.

Off-design ticks cost about 110 ms against 15 ms at the design seed (cProfile on a ramp to 90 %): the
bubble-point solves of 323C003 and 323F004 (220 s of 725), HV-322604's condensing letdown (69 s), the
vacuum train, 322C001 and 323F010 (45-60 s each). Turndown runs are therefore five to seven times
slower than the design point.

## LXXXIX.2 What the engine holds

Hold means of the points the workbook reports (`select_runs.py`: a PASS first, then the
best hold that only a slow level drift under 1 %/h kept from passing, then the best completed hold):

| Load | Maximum conversion | Minimum steam | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 70-85 % | — | — | trip 22.1 at 60-80 min on the design handles; collapse or trip on every other policy |
| 90 % | X 41.9 %, TT-322005 172.6 C, 901 73.1 t/h, 1 292 kg/t (design handles, HIC-322604 on PT-329201) | the same | FAIL: 323F010 drained, 328D003 1.9 %/h, carbon balance 87 % |
| 95 % | — | — | the plant's 92 % set points trip 22.1 at 21 min; the other policies abandoned collapsing |
| 100 % | TT-322004 176 C: X 55.94 %, 901 62.88 t/h, 850 kg/t | design: X 54.18 %, 901 60.86 t/h, 835 kg/t | PASS both, every licensor window met |
| 105 % | TT-322004 170 C: X 52.92 %, 901 60.53 t/h, 813 kg/t | the same | FAIL: 328D003 +0.75 %/h only |
| 110 % | X 52.10 %, 901 61.20 t/h, 782 kg/t | the same | FAIL: 323F010 137 %, HV-322604 deposition |
| 115 % | X 60.80 %, 901 68.33 t/h, 797 kg/t | the same | FAIL: 323F010 258 %, TT-322005 184.7 C |

At 100 % more stripping raises the conversion (172 / 174 / 176 C: 54.18 / 54.98 / 55.94 %) and costs
steam (835 / 840 / 850 kg/t); at 105 % less stripping raises both the conversion and the economy (175 /
172 / 170 C: 51.71 / 52.56 / 52.92 %). One 321P002 machine suffices at every load (321P002B's scoop
96 % at 115 %).

## LXXXIX.3 323F010's barometric leg (B-119)

`pre_evaporator.barometric_leg_kgh` drives PFD 317 by sqrt((M g / A + P_separator) / dP_des), and the
0.46 bar a separator dominates the bracket, so the leg's drain hardly follows the holdup. Three hours
after TT-322004 was raised 4 K at 100 % load the separator still rose 2.5 %/h (60 to 78.5 %); at 105 %
HIC-323605 trimmed on the level held it at 61-64 % with the valve at 49-61 %; at 110 % it rose
13 %/h to 137 % of the full vessel; at 115 % it stood at 259 % after five hours and at 249-277 % with
HIC-323605 closed to 16-20 %. Below design it drains to its heel: 0.0 % at 90 and 95 %.

## LXXXIX.4 The stripper cut's oscillation (B-120)

At 100 % load PIC-329204 trimmed to TT-322004 168 C cycles with a period of about 1.1 h: urea leaving
the stripper 62-81 t/h, conversion 49-65 %, AT-322701 2.76-3.46, 308's wash 23-43 t/h, LT-322501 swinging
15 %; 164 C cycles harder (PT-329201 to 146.7 bar a) and 170 C the same way with LV-322501's erosion
flag and 322E001's seal at 0.979. 172 C (design), 174 C and 176 C settle.

## LXXXIX.5 Other measurements

* AT-322701 trimmed by FFIC-321404's ratio (proportional-dominant): 3.0 to 3.77 within 40 minutes at
  99 % load while the ratio went 2.023 to 2.166 and back to 2.01; the study held the ratio at design.
  The plant held FFIC-321404B at 2.115 and AY-322701 at 3.25 in 2023.
* 321P002B's scoop reached 96 % at 115 % load; the standby 321P002A rule (97 % for a minute) never
  fired, one pump at every load.
* With TIC-329005 lowered to stop 322E003 venting at 105-110 %, HV-322604's letdown cooled to 58 C and
  deposited carbamate (B-79's law); at 115 % with the tempered water at 67.5 C the letdown stayed at
  104 C and did not.
* 322E003 condenses its whole demand at design and no more (decision 157): the plant's 92 % tempered
  water, 90 C, makes it vent 7.2 t/h at once in the engine.

## XC.2 HIC-322605 by hand

With the funnel flooded, HV-322605 passes m_des . Kv(theta) / Kv(theta_des) whatever the level
(`reactor_hydraulics.outlet_line_outflow_kgh`). The level therefore integrates the difference between
the reactor's make and the valve, and only the operator closes that loop. One per cent of stroke near
60 % moves 3.6 t/h, which is 36 % of LT-322504's 1.5 m span an hour.

The study's operator re-typed HIC-322605 every 2 minutes on the ramp and every 5 minutes after, to
0.01 %. Each move sized the valve to pass the solution 322R001 is discharging: its discharge plus its
holdup's trend, smoothed over 4 minutes. It added what returns LT-322504 to 80 % over 30 minutes, and
inverted the sum through the vendor's Kv table (`hv322605_kv`). A move under 0.03 % was not made.

Settled at 100 % and 105 %, the operator made at most one move in the hour's hold (0.03 %). The
level met its criterion with the valve fixed. In the plant (Book2), HVGT-322605 stands at 0.50 times
the load in every band: 47.2 % at 92.3 %, 51.4 % at 102.5 %, 53.9 % at 108.6 % and 55.3 % at 111 %.

## XC.4 The turndown against the document's claims

On the ramp from 100 % at 0.5 %/min, the measurements contradict the document's claims:

* **The discharge does not follow the load.** 322R001 still discharged 222-228 t/h at 90 % (design
  226.2), and the hand station stayed within 1 % of 60 %. 308's wash stayed at 36.3-36.8 t/h; the
  document expects 33.2 at 90 %, with LIC-323502 on its 400 s integral.
* **AT-322701 rises with the cut.** With the fresh ratio fixed, it went from 3.00 to 3.30 at 90 % while
  the reactor feed's N/C moved only from 3.073 to 3.088. TT-322011 follows its correlation
  (`scrubber.py`, OFFGAS_T_GAIN on the N/C's deviation) from 114 to 147 C. 322E003's saturation
  fraction falls to 0.93 and 1.6-1.8 t/h of condensable gas passes to HV-322604. That holds on the
  document's baseline (intensive set points at design) and its thermal trims alike. In every run
  below 100 %, HV-322604's letdown condenses carbamate from the sixth minute (the deposition flag).
* **Conversion falls.** X drops below its pinned design within minutes, at 98 % load even on the
  slow ramp. V1's slip term (B-118) then carries the reactor to its cold branch. The document's
  expected 55.5-60.5 % at 95-80 % is reached at no load below 100 %.
* **The ratio lever makes it worse.** The ratio operator (M2) reached the 2.0 floor within twenty
  minutes, AT-322701 did not come back, and 322E003 vented more (2.4 against 1.8 t/h at 90 %) with
  conversion lower. The engine's conversion rises with the N/C: X 62 % at AT-322701 3.10 in session 76.

The plant at 92 % (Book2, 755 samples) runs differently: AY-322701 3.25, TT-322011 133.5 C and
TT-322005 182.6 C on FFIC-321404B 2.115, with TIC-329005 at 90 C and no venting. Its vent top at its
N/C is 11 K below what the engine's correlation gives (144 C at 3.25). Its N/C does not move with
load: 3.25 at 92, 102, 108.6 and 111 %.

## XC.5 Above design

The document's ramp-up NH3 lead was +1.5 % while the load rose, decaying over 30 minutes after. With
it, AT-322701 reached 3.6-3.9 at 105-110 %, and 2.5-2.7 in the swings at 110-115 %. 322E003 vented
1.0-8.3 t/h. At 115 % the reactor's liquid make swung from -9 to +24 t/h within ten minutes. The
hand station's five-minute moves did not hold LT-322504, which reached 100 %. 323F010 rose past full
at 105-115 % on B-119's leg.

Session 76's 105 % point by hand (R105s: no ratio lead, PIC-329204 on TT-322004 170 C, HIC-323605 on
323F010) fails only on 328D003. Its bays gain 3.2-3.7 t/h of ammonia water more than FIC-328402's
design 31.4 m3/h (31.1 t/h) takes; bay III holds 249.6 t at 58.6 %. Raising FIC-328402 once to
34.5 m3/h (R105f) holds the bays (+0.24 %/h), but 328C003's level falls 1.54 % in the hour while
LIC-328504 recovers from the step (corrected in §XCI.5). Raised as B-121.

# Part XCI — A pasted analysis of B-118 to B-121 checked and measured (Phase 7)

Session 78, 2026-10-30. A study, not a port: no relation, constant, test or document datum changed.
The process engineer sent another tool's analysis of session 77's four open items (B-118 to B-121),
with a diagnosis and a recommended change for each. Every claim it makes about the code was checked
against the source, and its mechanisms against session 77's run records. Each recommended change was
measured on the committed engine as a scratch patch. The session's `patched_run.py` replaces a module
global or wraps a function in its own process, then runs session 77's runner (Part XC), so nothing
under `ureasim/` was edited. The check also found two errors in Part XC's record of R105f, corrected
in place (XCI.5), and a 105 % hold that passes (XCI.3), which the workbook now reports.

## XCI.2 Its mechanisms against session 77's records

* **322E002 does not over-quench at turndown.** TT-322010 stays at 167.9-171.5 C at 80 and 90 %
  (M1_080, M1_090). Its melt's saturation fraction falls to 0.88-0.90 as the melt's N/C rises to
  3.4, so the condenser holds less gas and 322R001 receives more vapour than its design share.
  322R001's off-gas grows from 22.4 t/h to 46 t/h at 90 % and to 80 t/h at 80 %. The reactor is not
  starved of gas; it does not hold the gas it receives.
* **322E003's venting follows its saturation fraction, not TT-322011.** The fraction is 0.92-0.96
  while AT-322701 stands at 3.25-3.32, and the venting stops when AT-322701 falls back. The reactor
  keeps cooling after the venting stops. In M1_090, from 36 to 61 minutes, nothing is vented while
  conversion falls from 43.5 to 39.1 % and TT-322005 from 175.9 to 171.5 C.
* **The ratio cut did not reach the low-N/C branch.** M2_090 moved FFIC-321404 only from its design
  2.023 to the faceplate's floor, 2.000, and its trajectory follows M1_090's, whose ratio stayed at
  design. In both, the melt's N/C dips to 2.95 at the ramp's start and stands at 3.3-3.4 while
  322E003 vents most (16-26 minutes); PI-322E002 rises there to 149-150 bar on V1's K_N line above
  3.0.
* **323F010 drains below design, as claimed.** It is empty at 80-90 % with HIC-323605 wide open, and
  at 29 % at 95 %.
* **328C003's pressure does not fall in R105f.** PIC-328203 holds 16.80 bar a at the run's end and
  LIC-328504 is in AUTO. The level falls, not rises (XCI.5).

## XCI.4 Reading

* **B-118.** The analysis's diagnosis does not describe the engine, and its two changes do not hold
  80 or 90 %. The conductance's scaling delays the slide by about 20 minutes and no more. Switching
  off V1's conversion-deficit slip, the lead session 76 recorded, slows the off-gas's growth but not
  the slide. Every slide is preceded by the loop N/C's excursion on the ramp: AT-322701 reaches 3.3
  within 20 minutes with the fresh ratio fixed and 308's wash at its design rate, and the saturation
  fractions of 322E002 and 322E003 fall to 0.87-0.90 and 0.92-0.96. B-118 stays open, its option (b)
  narrowed to that excursion and to 322E003's margin at AT-322701 3.25.
* **B-119.** Not measured. The analysis's head rising with LI-323506 about 50 % (0.7 of the design
  flow at 30 %, 1.15 at 75 %) is option (b) with an assumed rangeability. The leg's geometry (its
  height, bore and seal pot) is the datum (b) needs; found and prototyped in §XCI.6.
* **B-120.** The stripper's slip gain sets the mode's size, as the analysis says and session 62
  attributed: X swings 4.8 points at V1's 4, 1.6 at 2 and 0.4 at 0. Operating HIC-322605 by hand
  already cuts session 76's swing to about a quarter. No gain gives a steady hold: at 2 LT-322501
  still swings 11 points, and at 0 the loop is steady but 323F010 drains 16 %/h (B-119) and
  AT-322701 stands at 3.15. The gain is V1's calibration, sourced to nothing but `main.py`.
* **B-121.** The analysis's +4.5 % is short of the balance. Ten per cent on FIC-328402 holds 105 %
  once LIC-328504 has settled 328C003, about three hours after the step. The plant moves FIC-328402
  about 4 % from 102 to 108.6 % (Book2), so the engine's ammonia water grows faster with load than
  the plant's.

* **R105f's 328C003 level fell.** It dropped 1.54 % over the hold (-1.65 %/h least squares) while

## XCI.6 323F010's barometric leg on its drawings, option (b) prototyped (B-119)

B-119's option (b) needs the leg's geometry, and the archive has it:

* **The leg.** Isometric UD-RL-100-MB-0142, line 200-US6-323256-EC07DB-W80 (P&ID 105/1; design 2 and
  -1.0 bar g, 165 C), runs from 323F010/N2 at EL +15 740. It passes through 0.9 m of DN 400 and a
  400 x 200 reducer at EL +14 722, then 13.4 m of 219.1 x 4.5 pipe, to 323D002/N1 at EL +6 095.
  TT-323012's thermowell is at its foot, EL +6 210. The elevations were read from the scan and
  checked on a magnified crop.
* **The seal.** 323D002's general assembly (UD-AU-323-TL-0001): N1, the DN 200 urea-solution inlet,
  carries a dip pipe. It stands 5 295 mm above the reference level, the bottom plate's underside at
  EL +800, which is the isometric's EL +6 095. The tank's design liquid level is 4.95 m, and its
  name plate gives the solution's density as 1 173.94 kg/m3.
* **The premise.** A full vacuum holds 101 325 / (1 151 x 9.806 65) = 8.98 m of PFD 317's melt
  (8.80 m at the name plate's 1 173.94 kg/m3). With 323D002 at its design liquid level (EL +5 750),
  the column's top at full vacuum stands at EL +14 727, 1.01 m below N2. The leg therefore never fills to the separator. The melt falls
  through N2 into a leg whose space above the column stands at the separator's pressure, so the
  separator drains on its own head. V1's law (report A-17) takes the leg as a column standing full
  to the separator, rho g h_leg = P_atm. That puts the separator's absolute pressure into the drive,
  and it is why the drain hardly answers the holdup.
* **Option (b) as a prototype.** m_317 = m_317,des . sqrt(M / M_des), the orifice law on the
  separator's own head. It is anchored on V1's design holdup (6 183.3 kg) and drain
  (92 748.9 kg/h), so the design point is the same to the bit:

| run | case | 323F010 | the hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| X119D_100 | M1_100, the design | 60.0 % | PASS: X 54.19 %, 835 kg/t, as M1_100 |
| X119_090 | M1_090 | 36 % at 60 minutes (empty on V1's law) | stopped: the synthesis slides as in M1_090 (B-118), X 39.7 %, TT-322005 171.0 C |
| X119_110 | session 76's CF110_t175 policy, HIC-322605 by hand, HIC-323605 fixed at 64.08 % | 71.9 % (201 % within two hours on V1's law, session 77) | FAIL: 324E001's level -4.47 %/h and HV-322604's deposition flag; AT-322701 2.75, X 54.03 %, 815 kg/t |
| X119_115 | the same at 115 % | 85-89 % | trips 21.10, 21.2, 21.8, 22.1 and 22.2 at 121 minutes: 322E003's sump empties with HIC-322602 wide open and 308 at 20 t/h, 322R001 floods, then the stripper's sump empties |
| X119G0 | B-120's 168 C case, SLIP_GAIN 0 | 54.7-59 % (-16 %/h on V1's law) | FAIL: LT-322504 +3.44 %/h; AT-322701 3.15; carbon yield 0.956 |

With the leg on its own head, 323F010 settles where its throughput puts it, 60 % x (m / m_des)^2
(72.6 % at 110 %), from 90 to 115 % load, and it neither drains nor floods. The holds that still
fail, fail elsewhere: on 324E001's level and HV-322604's deposition at 110 %, on a loop excursion

# Part XCII — B-122 built; B-121 and B-118 traced against Book2's bands (Phase 7)

Session 79 (2026-10-30) took up the four open Section B items on a pasted plan from the process
engineer: B-122 option (b), to trace 323F010's boil-off spikes and remove what the physics does not
ask for; B-121 option (b) and B-118 / B-120's narrowed option (b), to measure against Book2.xlsx's
plant bands and report before any relation changes. One relation's numerics changed, B-122's
(decision 162); B-121 and B-118 changed nothing under `ureasim/`. The runs, the traces and the
prototypes are in the session's scratchpad (`trace_b122.py`, `proto2_b122.py`, `stage_surge.py`,
`b121_bands.py`, `probe_lp_gas.py`, `b121_option.py`, `trace_b118.py`, `b118_e003.py`). Resumed on
2026-10-31 after a pause, the session kept the synthesis loop's harness on the linearised step and
closed B-123 on the process engineer's sign-off (§XCII.2; `trace_synth_b122.py`,
`trace_b106_split.py`, `lp_ring_b106.py`, `switch_sides_b122.py`).

## XCII.1 B-122: the spikes traced

The dynamic audit's fast shutdown (trip 21.2 by its switch, LV-322501 forced wide open, two
minutes at FAST) feeds 323F010 up to 192 t/h. Its liquor holds 1 to 12 mK above its bubble point,
and each tick its boil-off is the root of T* - x lambda / C = T_bub(w'(x), P) at the trial pressure
(`holdup_boil.liquor_boil`, B-24), inside PT-323204's backward step linearised about the old
pressure, P' = P + f dt / (1 - J dt), J taken on a 1e-6 bar probe. Traced inside the tick on the
decided leg (ticks 662-670):

| tick | Tb(P) - T* [mK] | boil at P, at the probe [kg/h] | step of PT-323204 [bar] | boil booked [kg/h] |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 662 | -12.3 | 2003.3, 1994.5 | +0.88e-4 | 1231 |
| 663 | -1.6 (Tb +10.6 mK: CO2 crosses 7.5e-4) | 256.1, 247.7 | -1.06e-4 | 1157 |
| 665 | -23.5 | 2269.263, 2269.263 (pinned) | +24.1e-4 | 0 |
| 666 | +95.1 | 0, 0 | -30.8e-4 | 8961 |
| 667 | -26.6 | 3061.6, 3061.6 (pinned) | +44.3e-4 | 0 |
| 669 | +15.9 | 0, 0 | -28.5e-4 | 20627 |

Two things break the linearisation:

* **The kink at the bubble point.** The boil-off is zero above the pressure that brings the liquor
  to its bubble point and falls about 9 t/h per mbar below it (C / lambda = 7.8 kg/K, dT_bub/dP =
  54 K/bar). A start subcooled by a fraction of a millikelvin leaves the probe with the valve's
  slope alone, the step overshoots into the boiling region, and a flash is booked that the pressure
  step never saw. The memo's bubble point steps 6 to 26 mK where the liquor crosses a bin edge (CO2,
  a few quanta of 1e-4, crossing 7.5e-4 at tick 663), which is what puts a start on the wrong side.
* **A root pinned on a bin edge.** When the boiled liquor's composition crosses a bin edge inside
  the root's bracket, the bubble point steps and the root sits on the step: at ticks 665 and 667 it
  is the same to the bit at the old pressure and at the probe, and the Jacobian again loses the
  boil.

V1's leg shows the same mechanism, two successive reversals eleven times. At the stage alone the
linearised step books 172.5 t/h on the first tick of HV-323605 opened to 1.6 times its capacity at
0.1 s and rings PT-323204 through eleven successive reversals when 324E002's shell falls to
0.25 bar a at 1 s; the equivalence transcription, which carries the same code, had booked
single-tick flashes of 165, 30 and 17 t/h in its own scenarios.

## XCII.2 B-122 (b) built (decision 162)

On a tick where the holdup boils at the old pressure, at the probe or at the linearised step's end,
`PreEvaporator.step` solves the backward step itself, P' = P + f(P') dt, by
`core.node.backward_euler_pressure` (V1's `_backward_euler_p`, ported verbatim) between the old
pressure and the explicit step, where a falling f puts its root, clamped to the separator's range.
Elsewhere the linearised step is kept to the bit, and at a settled state f(P) is 0 and both return
P. The transcription in `tests/equivalence/test_pre_evaporator_equivalence.py` carries it under
``boil_decided``, every tick-by-tick scenario `==` the port; ``boil_decided=False`` is V1 verbatim.

| fast shutdown, 1 215 ticks | decided leg, before | after | V1's leg, before | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| longest run of PT-323204 reversals | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| runs of two | 10 | 7 | 11 | 4 |
| boil-off spikes (> 1.3 x both neighbours) | 11 | 0 | 6 | 0 |
| largest tick-to-tick change of evaporation + boil-off [kg/h] | 20 647 | 457 | 18 092 | 1 032 |

The audit's limit of two successive reversals is restored for every node
(`tests/engine/test_dynamic_audit.py`). At the stage alone the opened vent flashes 6.93 t/h at once
and moves at most 235 kg/h a tick; the falling shell moves PT-323204 to 0.4557 bar a without a
reversal (section 7 of `tests/units/recirc/test_pre_evaporator.py`).

Three other fixes were measured and set aside:

* one memo bin's expansion frozen per tick: the pin goes, but the bin switches between ticks, and a
  quiet boil at TIC-323012's 101 C chattered between 492 and 855 kg/h (longest run 4 on the audit);
* the rigorous bubble point expanded about the tick's own state (`kvalues` Newton from the memo's
  estimate): the smoothest, 56 kg/h, but up to 0.035 C off the memo that V1's relaxation uses, so a
  liquor relaxing at 97 C boiled 5.3 kg/h that it should not, and every boiling state moved by the
  memo's local error;
* the exact step only where the boil starts or stops: the pinned root escapes it, longest run 3 and
  a 19 t/h step.

What moved. Every non-boiling tick and every fixed point is unchanged; the design seed's first tick
is the PFD to the bit. The boiling scenarios' transients moved, and the stage's tests were measured
again: among them the 0.1 s stopped drain's first-tick boil-off 9120.0 to 9307.9 kg/h, the B-98 heel
reached at 5260 s instead of 5290, the B-24 deeper vacuum's boil-off at two hours 3287.54 to 3287.42
kg/h (PT-323204 0.40424 bar a, unchanged), and the design seed's hour at 1 s, where the liquor
touches its bubble point, 80.00038 to 80.00017 % urea and 0.00 to 0.03 kg/h boiled. Three decided
tests of the equivalence file moved with the transcription: V1's trim pulls 13 793 kg/h on the
first tick of the shell's fall (13 638), the 60 % chest boils 1179.23 kg/h (1176.10), and V1's
chest reaches 97.75 C at twenty minutes (97.73).

The synthesis loop's harness (2026-10-31). `harness_plant` in
`tests/equivalence/test_synthesis_loop_equivalence.py` runs the port's whole plant, 323F010 with it,
and its decided transients boil the holdup: B-104's (LV-322501 at 10 %) on 3 782 of 6 001 ticks from
the eighth, with single-tick flashes up to 130 t/h on the linearised step (81 t/h solved itself);
B-106's (the CO2 boundary +20 %) on 1 139 of 2 001 from the thirtieth, up to 31 t/h (3.2 t/h). The
step's difference reaches the loop through the LP header, which 323E010's chest draws on, and the
harness's knife edges answer it at length. In B-104's scenario the LPCC stands 1.3 mbar apart at ten
minutes, and LV-322501's drain at 10 % (12.2 t/h on 1.5 mbar, decision 150) moves the reactor's
discharge from 37.67 to 26.26 t/h. In B-106's the first boiling ticks differ by 5 kg/h and the LP
header by 0.2 mbar at 33 s; on the harness's V1 switches the header rings period-two in that
transient — 36 successive reversals, its tick-to-tick step alternating by up to 33 mbar, where the
product's plant never reverses twice running — and the difference grows to 42 mbar at 100 s, the
melt condensing 108.95 t/h instead of 74.27 and trip 22.2 coming at 193.0 s instead of 190.7. Six
decided tests and V1's side of A-12's CO2 case (139.5473 to 139.5470 bar a) moved, all through the
LP side. The harness keeps the linearised step, ``PreEvaporator(exact_boil_step=False)``, as it keeps
V1's leg (decision 161), and every pin stands as committed. The switch's two sides are asserted at
the stage (section 7 of `tests/units/recirc/test_pre_evaporator.py`): the linearised step books
172.5 t/h on the opened vent's first tick and rings the falling shell's PT-323204 through eleven
successive reversals.

What remains is V1's memo itself (handoff B-123): its bubble point steps up to 0.026 C at a bin edge
and its flash's vapour CO2 8 %, so a quiet boil at 101 C chatters PT-323204 by ±0.012 mbar and the
stage alone under a 2.75-fold feed surge rings period-two at ±0.22 mbar on the vapour's composition —
before and after the fix. The process engineer signed it off as built on 2026-10-31 (option (a),
decision 163): the chatter lies below the transmitter's resolution, and V1's memo stays as ported.

## XCII.4 B-118: the ramp's N/C excursion and 322E003's margin

The first 25 minutes of the design handles' ramp to 90 % (0.5 %/min, 323F010 on its own head), with
`reactor_322r001`'s overflow N/C (atom basis) recorded after each of its four steps:

| t [s] | AT-322701 | real feed | out_total | re-flashed split | + NH3 partition | + slip | l_feed (driver) | X |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 3.000 | 3.112 | 3.063 | 3.001 | 3.001 | 3.001 | 3.0730 | 0.5419 |
| 245 | 3.115 | 3.257 | 3.208 | 3.134 | 3.136 | 3.136 | 3.0805 | 0.5471 |
| 365 | 3.113 | 3.013 | 2.966 | 2.913 | 2.916 | 2.916 | 3.0832 | 0.5318 |
| 725 | 3.151 | 3.306 | 3.256 | 3.177 | 3.181 | 3.181 | 3.0869 | 0.5465 |
| 965 | 3.312 | 3.472 | 3.421 | 3.327 | 3.332 | 3.332 | 3.0876 | 0.5422 |
| 1205 | 3.541 | 3.759 | 3.705 | 3.584 | 3.590 | 3.588 | 3.0884 | 0.5330 |
| 1325 | 3.704 | 3.961 | 3.904 | 3.763 | 3.767 | 3.764 | 3.0844 | 0.5282 |

The NH3 partition (``NC_OVERFLOW_GAIN``, at most 9.4 kmol/h) moves the overflow's N/C by at most
+0.006 and the conversion-deficit slip by at most 0.006; the re-flashed split takes a steady 0.06 to
0.14 off it. AT-322701 follows the reactor's real feed, 322E002's melt and gas, which the reactor
carries atom for atom. The 3.073-3.088 that session 77 recorded is ``l_feed``, the blended driver
(30 % the fresh ratio's prompt, ``NC_LOOP_GAIN`` 0.5 on FFIC-321404's PV, and 70 % its lag on the
loop inventory, V1's construction), which sets the kinetics and the partition and never sees the
loop's composition. So the reactor converts at the driver's 3.08 while its overflow, and 322E003's
gas behind it, carry the loop's 3.3-3.7.

The anchor. The engine's AT-322701 of 3.00 is the PFD's design overflow on an atom basis (2.99975,
`unit_322e003`'s reference). Book2's AY-322701 stands at 3.25 in every band (3.21-3.61 between the
10th and 90th percentiles at 92 %), above the licensor's 2.90-3.10: the plant runs NH3-richer than
the design at every load, and the engine's correlations anchored at 3.00 — TT-322011 at 120 K per
N/C unit — read 144 C at 3.25 where the plant reads 130-134 C.

322E003's margin. At Book2's 92 % set points (TIC-329005 90 C, FFIC-321404 2.115, the LP header 4.11 bar g,
PIC-329204 18.2 bar g, HIC-322604 51.5 %), applied at the design seed and ramped to 92 % at
0.5 %/min (`b118_e003.py`), 322E003 leaves 1.51 t/h uncondensed within 30 s and 7.6-7.8 t/h at 20
to 22 minutes. The term is the saturation fraction on its own liquor's bubble pressure (decision
105): f is 0.927 at once, the liquor bubbling at 145.5 bar a against the loop's 140.7, and falls to
0.763 as AT-322701 climbs past 3.9 and the bubble pressure to 156.2 bar a. Held at 1, f leaves at
most 0.47 t/h, while the shell's capacity fraction (decisions 136, 157) dips to 0.979 for six
minutes; the capacity held at 1 leaves the run unchanged to the kilogram. At the plant's ratio the
engine's AT-322701 runs to 4.27 in 28 minutes, where the plant holds 3.25. On the design handles f
never binds, but the overflow cools from 165 to 99 C, the sump fills, and from 24 minutes the
full-sump rule vents 20-27 t/h.

B-120's coupling — whether these damp the 1.1 h loop mode at TT-322004 166.6-168 C with V1's slip
gain of 4 — was not measured.

## XCIII.3 FFIC-321404's basis (B-118)

The engine's FFIC-321404 ratio is ``m_NH3 / m_CO2,feed x 44.009 / 17.031`` on the whole CO2 feed
gas, so its design 2.0231 is a true molar 2.086 (the PFD's feed gas: CO2 0.9524 mol fraction, molar
mass 43.21, CO2 mass fraction 0.970). The plant's FFIC-321404B reads the true molar ratio:
FY-321401's 40.0 t/h of NH3 against FY-322403's 26 110 Nm3/h of feed gas at 95.24 % CO2 gives 2.117
against the displayed 2.115. On the engine's basis the plant runs 2.047-2.053 in every band, flat
with load. Session 79's runs at the plant's ratio (§XCII.4) entered 2.115 on the engine's basis, a
true 2.18 — 3 % more NH3 than the plant feeds.

| run | load | ratio (engine basis) | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Book2's 92 % set points | 92.3 % | 2.115 | AT-322701 3.70 at 19 min, 322E003 venting 7.0 t/h, trip 22.1 at 19 min |
| Book2's 92 % set points | 92.3 % | 2.052 | AT-322701 3.44 at 31 min, venting 4.9 t/h, trip 22.1 at 31 min |
| design handles | 100 % | 2.052 | AT-322701 3.00 to 3.35 at 31 min, 3.05 at 61, 3.21 at 91, settled at 3.14 from 140 min; the 1-hour hold passes: X 56.46 %, 836 kg/t, 1 782 MTPD |

The basis accounts for the speed of session 79's runaway, not for the trip: at the plant's ratio on
the engine's basis Book2's 92 % set points still trip, 322E003 venting at TIC-329005's 90 C on its
saturation fraction (§XCII.4). At 100 % the plant's ratio holds: the step excites the loop's ~1 h
mode (B-120), which damps in two cycles, and AT-322701 settles at 3.14 against the plant's 3.25,
conversion 2.3 points above the design run's and the steam per tonne about 3 % higher.

## XCIII.4 The streams into 322E002 on the turndown ramps (B-118)

`trace80_b118.py`: the committed engine from the design seed on the design handles, the CO2 demand
ramped at 0.5 %/min; every 10 s the N and C atoms [kmol/h] of 322E001's top gas, the motive NH3
after its battery-limit transit, 322F001's suction (322E003's overflow), 308 and LV-322501's drain.

| t [s] | load | feed N/C | AT-322701 | top gas N / C | top N/C | suction N | motive N | drain N |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 1.000 | 3.11 | 3.00 | 3 662 / 1 884 | 1.94 | 1 325 | 2 505 | 3 045 |
| 970 | 0.920 | 3.47 | 3.31 | 4 045 / 1 774 | 2.28 | 1 128 | 2 409 | 3 101 |
| 1 330 | 0.900 | 3.96 | 3.70 | 4 507 / 1 678 | 2.69 | 669 | 2 341 | 3 290 |
| 1 810 | 0.900 | 3.31 | 3.16 | 2 566 / 1 456 | 1.76 | 0 | 2 263 | 2 360 |
| 2 290 | 0.900 | 3.06 | 2.95 | 2 095 / 1 418 | 1.48 | 0 | 2 254 | 2 019 |

The rise from 3.11 to 3.47 in the first 16 minutes and on to 3.96 is 322E001's top gas: its
nitrogen grows 23 % and its carbon falls 11 % while the load falls 10 %. The stripper, at its design
shell pressure, gives the loop's ammonia back to 322E002 faster than the fresh feed falls, and only
LV-322501's drain takes ammonia out of the loop (+8 %). The wash is constant and the motive follows
the load. 322F001 stalls 4-10 minutes after the ramp ends, its spindle at the design 74 % for a
motive of 90 %; with the suction gone the top gas falls and AT-322701 returns to 2.95. On the ramp
to 80 % the same rise reaches 3.76 at 90 % load, the stall comes at 86-88 %, and the loop's
circulation then collapses (the drain's nitrogen 3 045 to 1 092 kmol/h, 308's 663 to 220). A PI on
AT-322701 onto the ratio holds nothing: it reaches the faceplate's 2.0 floor (1.1 % less NH3 than
the design) and AT-322701 peaks at 3.76. The battery-limit transits pass the live feeds for their
first ~350 s from the seed, both together, so the fresh ratio is not disturbed.

Why the plant holds AY-322701 at 3.25: its ratio on the engine's basis is 2.05, not 2.115 (§XCIII.3);
it closes 322F001's spindle with load (Book2's HIC-322602 63 % at 92 % against the design's 74 %),
so the ejector never stalls; and its 322E003 does not vent at 90 C. The engine reproduces the first
two as operator moves; the third is B-118's 322E003 margin.

## XCIII.5 Every controller's load relation

`inventory80.py` walked the committed plant at its design seed: 81 control objects, 47 inline
faceplates, 26 operator entries. `schedule80.py` classified the 72 controllers and hand stations
of units 320 to 335 and derived each one's relation from the engine's own equations, evaluated
70-115 % and set against the medians of Book2's 92.3, 102.5, 108.6 and 111.0 % bands
(`book2_bands80.json`, all 144 columns):

* 34 automatic loops whose set point is fixed with load: every level loop, the stage temperatures,
  the fixed pressures;
* 9 standalone automatic loops whose set point scales with load: TIC-329005 (322E003's capacity
  eps.C.(T_proc - T_ccw) held at L times the design's: 185 - 105 L, capped at the set point's 95
  C), PIC-329204 (the shell saturation whose LMTD on the design tube profile is L times the
  design's), MASTER-329207 (+0.015 bar per 1 % cut), FIC-328402, FIC-323418, FIC-323401,
  FIC-323402 and FIC-329402 (in proportion to load), PIC-323202 (B-121);
* 11 cascade or ratio slaves that follow their master; 3 ratio stations, FFIC-321404B on the
  engine's basis with no load term;
* 4 hand stations moved with load: HIC-322605 (Kv in proportion to load, trimmed on LT-322504),
  HIC-322602 (322F001 entraining L times its design suction at L times its design motive),
  HIC-322604 (the equal-percentage inverse, 72 + 100 ln L / ln 50), HIC-323605 (the Neldisc
  stroke pulling L times the design vapour at 0.46 bar a); 11 hand stations held.

Against Book2's slopes: HIC-322604 +0.256 %/% (plant +0.243), PIC-329204 +0.121 bar/% (+0.097),
MASTER-329207 -0.015 bar/% (-0.011), SIC-323901 +0.60 rpm/% (+0.61), SIC-321951 +0.84 %/%
(+0.81), FIC-328402 in proportion (the plant's 39.5 m3/h at 100 % against the engine's 31.4).
Three diverge: HIC-322602 (+2.2 against +0.67 %/%, the plant holding LT-329501 at 7-11 %),
TIC-329005 (-1.05 against -0.54 C/%, the plant at 85.7 C at 100 %) and HIC-322605 (+0.62 against
+0.43 %/%, the plant at 50.4 % at 100 %). The plant also holds several level set points the engine
does not: LIC-322501 65 % (engine 50), LIC-323501 40 (60), LIC-323505 22 (60), LIC-329503 40 (50),
LIC-323507 16-22 (10). TIC-328012 is faceplate-only (V1), so FIC-329402 stays at 1 105 kg/h unless
it is scheduled.

## XCIII.6 The schedule applied, 70-115 % (the directive's step 3)

`sched_run80.py` is the load-optimisation runner (`opt_run80.py`) with the directive's relations
and trims added; every move goes through the engine's command handlers at the fixed 0.1 s step.
Each run starts from the design seed, ramps the CO2 demand at 0.5 %/min, settles three hours with
the trims acting, and holds one hour with only the level trims acting; the verdict is the earlier
study's (`analyze.py`: every level's least-squares slope and net change under 0.5, no relief,
overflow, lost suction, held-back liquor, broken seal, mushy flow, stall, deposition, trip or flag).

* On their relations at the live load: TIC-329005 (the capacity law, capped at its set point's
  95 C), PIC-329204 (the LMTD law), MASTER-329207, FIC-323401, FIC-323402, FIC-329409 (306 t/h),
  HIC-322604 (the equal-percentage inverse); FIC-328402 and FIC-329402 in proportion to load with
  one shared bias; FIC-323418 in proportion to load. HIC-323605, not on the directive's list, kept
  its design 64.1 %.
* Trims: HIC-322605 by hand on 322R001's discharge and LT-322504 at 80 % (the session-77 operator);
  HIC-322602 solved each step for the suction that holds LT-329501 at 50 %; FFIC-321404B by an
  operator who reads AY-322701's ten-minute mean and steps the ratio by at most 0.004 outside a 0.04
  dead band, 2.0-2.10 on the engine's basis, from the design 2.023; the FIC-328402 / FIC-329402 bias
  on 328D003's level (its three bays level together); TIC-329005 cooled below its law, 0.15 C per
  10 s, while 322E003 passes more than 300 kg/h of condensable gas, and relaxed back once it passes
  less than 50; PIC-323202 at the loop summary's 3.9 bar a, TIC-323013 out of its masterless
  cascade into AUTO, colder only while PV-323202 vents, FIC-323418 cut back while LT-323503 is
  below 40 %. At 110 and 115 % a loop-pressure guard (HIC-322604 opened and MASTER-329207 lowered
  above 145 bar a) and the standby pump on the ratio's shortfall were added after the first runs
  tripped.
* The objectives differ only in their targets. Conversion (C): AT-322701 3.25, TT-322004 174 C
  through a bias on PIC-329204's law, TT-322005 183 C through a bias on MASTER-329207's. Steam (S):
  AT-322701 3.00, TT-322004 170 C (the LMTD law is its floor: the bias cannot cut below it, so S runs
  on the law), MASTER-329207 on its law guarded to keep PV-329207A shut and PV-329207C's letdown down.

A first version with a PI trim on AT-322701 (0.08 per unit N/C, 0.003 per minute) was stopped
after 35 minutes: at 105 % it pushed the ratio to 2.078 on an AT-322701 dip and AT-322701 then
overshot to 3.9, the loop's N/C lagging the ratio by 20-30 minutes; and below 95 % TIC-329005's law
rose faster on the ramp (0.53 C/min) than its correction (0.3 C/min) while 322E003 vented 4-6 t/h.

Session 76's growing ~1.1 h cycle did not appear at 168 C with the operator on the ratio and on

  ±15 %), with 328D003's pair trim made faster (kc 0.15, ti 5 400 s).

# Part XCIV — B-118 and B-120's narrowed option (b) measured at Book2's 92.3 and 111 % bands (Phase 7)

Session 81 (2026-11-04) measured the two narrowed options (b) that Session 80 recommended, as scratch
patches in the session's scratchpad, on the process engineer's pasted plan. For B-118, 322E001's
overhead at its design shell pressure on the turndown ramp and 322E003's liquor bubble-pressure
margin at AY-322701 3.25 and TIC-329005 90 C, with Book2's 92.3 % band as the acceptance test and the
Phase 7 cold start and trip 22.2 as the checks. For B-120, 322E003's carbamate make against
322F001's entrainment at a full spindle and 322E001's H/C slip, at Book2's 111 % band. Nothing under
`ureasim/` changed; the runners, patches and records are in the session's scratchpad.

## XCIV.1 The harness

`opt_run81.py` is Session 80's `opt_run80.py` with a configurable sample interval and diagnostics
added to every sample: 322E003's sump bubble pressure, 322E001's overhead fractions and split terms,
LV-322501's drain, 322E003's make, recondensed backlog and pulse, and 322F001's suction at HIC-322602
100 % evaluated on the live state (the ejector is a pure function; the plant is not touched).
`patch81.py` rebinds each candidate where its caller reads it at call time: 322E003's liquor design
head as `synthesis_loop.LIQUOR_DP_DES_BAR` (the scrubber's 0 bar, the name `_322e003` passes to
`saturation_fraction`), the liquor's N/C slope as `scrubber.BUB_KN`, 322E001's design overhead
fraction through a wrapper on `synthesis.stripper_322e001`, and `stripper.SLIP_GAIN`. Session 80's
92.3 % run re-run on it (A0) reproduces the record: trip 22.1 at 1 860 s, and the eight logged fields compared (AT-322701,
PT-329201, 322E003's saturation fraction, TT-322002, its vent, X, LT-329501 and HIC-322602) identical
in every one of the 31 common samples.

The design-pin gate ran 100 ticks from the design seed, patched and unpatched, every numeric leaf of
every step result compared. Two unpatched runs are identical to the bit. The split wrapper, its load
capped at 1, is identical to the bit. A margin or a slope is not, and cannot be: after 100 ticks the
committed seed's 322E003 liquor has a bubble pressure 0.0056 bar above the loop's (f = 0.99991), so any
positive margin makes f exactly 1 and the seed's trajectory moves by about 1e-5 (the largest change
a 0.08 kg/h recondensation). `SLIP_GAIN` = 0 moves it by about 1e-7: the seed's slip is 4.5e-5
(g_hc 0.99996). Book2's pressures are bar g; the plant's bands converted to bar a are PT-329201 138.39
(92.3 %) and 143.08 (111 %), PIC-329204 19.22 and 21.02, PT-329207 5.12 and 4.91.

## XCIV.3 322E003's liquor at Book2's 92.3 % set points (B-118)

At Book2's 92.3 % set points (TIC-329005 90 C, PIC-329204 19.22 bar a, MASTER-329207 5.123 bar a,
HIC-322604 51.5 %, the ratio 2.0516 on the engine's basis) the deficit is temperature first. The
law's temperature part is P_T(T) = P_206 exp[(dH/R)(1/T_206 - 1/T)] on PFD 206's own composition,
and the composition factor is the logged bubble pressure over it.

| state | AT-322701 | TT-322002 [C] | P_bub [bar a] | P_T | composition factor | P_bub - 138.39 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RC100's end, 100 %, TIC-329005 80 C, steady | 3.246 | 156.66 | 128.30 | 124.47 | 1.031 | -10.1 |
| A40 at 900 s, 92.3 % | 3.411 | 169.3 | 159.1 | 149.6 | 1.063 | 20.7 |
| A40 at 1 500 s | 3.708 | 172.3 | 174.5 | 156.0 | 1.118 | 36.1 |
| A40 at 2 100 s | 3.234 | 173.7 | 168.7 | 159.1 | 1.060 | 30.3 |
| A40's hold, TIC-329005 at 90.0 C | 3.078 | 177.9 | 170.1 | 168.55 | 1.009 | 31.7 |

TT-322002 follows the tempered water: the overflow is t_ccw,in + Q / UA_eff (the shell's NTU bridge),
+1 K per K of TIC-329005 at a given duty, plus 12 K per unit of HV-322604's opening deviation (+3.4 K
at 51.5 %). TIC-329005's PV climbs 0.2-0.3 C/min and reaches 90 C, and the liquor 177.9 C in A40's hold. The
plant's TT-322002 stays at 165.7-167.5 C in every band: 166.75 C at 92 % with TIC-329005 at 90 C,
167.5 C at 111 % with it at 80 C. At a steady AT-322701 3.25 the composition factor is 1.031. At TIC-329005 90 C (TT-322002 177.9 C,
A40's hold) the liquor's bubble pressure is then 173.7 bar a, 35.4 bar above the plant's 138.39 bar
a: 30.2 bar of temperature and 5.2 of composition. That is the minimum margin m* at AY-322701 3.25
and TIC-329005 90 C. At the plant's 166.75 C it would be 10.3 bar. No N/C slope closes the deficit,
since the temperature part alone leaves 30.2 bar. Through the loop's swing the composition factor
reached 1.118, and the bubble pressure stood 34.5 bar above the live loop pressure. The Extended UNIQUAC model offers
no independent anchor: it puts PFD 206's bubble point at 78 bar a at 165 C, with a negative slope
above it.

## XCV.3 TT-322002 against Book2's bands (B-118, B-120)

### The relation as built

`scrubber_322e003` publishes the liquor's temperature from the shell's effectiveness-NTU bridge
(V1's `scrub_322e003`):

    T_bridge = min(T_ccw,in + Q / UA_eff, T_proc)           T_proc = 185 C, the ceiling
    Q = Q_des . s . (P / P_des) . chi_spindle . chi_choke     85 K over UA_eff at design
    TT-322002 = max(T_bridge - 12 (HIC-322604 / 72 - 1), T_ccw,in) + wash and carry blends

It rises 1 K per K of TIC-329005, with the load and the loop pressure, with a 322F001 spindle
closed past its design 74 %, and by 12 K per unit of HV-322604's closure. The plant's TT-322002
holds 165.7-167.5 C across Book2's four bands, while TIC-329005 runs 80-90 C, HIC-322604 51.5-56 % and
HV-322602 63-76 %. Evaluated on each band's set points, at design circulation and a sump below 50 %:

| band (Book2) | load [%] | PT-329201 [bar a] | TIC-329005 | HIC-322604 | HV-322602 | plant TT-322002 | the law | T_cond(P) | P1 | plant TDY-329125 [K] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ~92 % | 92.3 | 138.39 | 90.0 | 51.5 | 63 | 166.75 | 175.9 | 164.8 | 168.3 | 25.7 |
| ~102 % | 102.5 | 141.97 | 84.1 | 53.9 | 69 | 165.74 | 178.2 | 165.1 | 168.1 | 26.8 |
| ~108 % | 108.6 | 142.51 | 80.9 | 55.5 | 73 | 167.14 | 178.0 | 165.1 | 167.9 | 28.5 |
| ~111 % | 111.0 | 143.08 | 80.0 | 56.0 | 76 | 167.50 | 176.9 | 165.2 | 167.8 | 28.8 |

The law runs 9-12 K above the plant on the plant's own set points. On the bubble side, the liquor
law at the plant's own TT-322002, with the composition factor of the nearest engine hold (A40's 1.004
at 92.3 %, RC100's 1.031 near 102 %, B0L's 0.885 above 105 %), stands 6.4 and 4.6 bar above the loop
at the ~92 and ~102 % bands (saturation fractions 0.90 and 0.93), and 14 bar below it above 105 %.
Book2 also carries TDY-329125, the tempered water's rise across 322E003: 25.7-28.8 K, against the
engine's design 15 K. FV-329409 is a valve opening (41-46 %), not a flow, so the plant's circulation
is not known.

The shell's own condensing temperature, `condensing_temperature_c` (V1's `scrub_cond_t_c`, 160 kJ/mol,
165.0 C at 140.7 bar a, 0.07 K/bar), holds 164.8-165.2 C over the bands' pressures. It already sets
the shell's driving force in `condensation_capacity`.

**The liquor's temperature acts on the process only through its saturation fraction.** Its
consumers are the sump's bubble pressure (the saturation fraction on the next tick), the mushy factor
(a 60 C floor), the TT-322002 lag and the packet. 322F001's discharge is on its design suction
temperature (`T_SUCTION_DES_C`), so 322E003's liquor carries no heat into 322E002 or 322R001.

**LT-329501 cannot reach Book2's levels.** 322F001's suction is its capacity times the sump level over
50 % (capped at 1.25). Evaluated on the holds' own motive and pressures, it entrains:

| hold | the sump's need (make + backlog) [t/h] | at Book2's level, spindle at its 10 % floor [t/h] | at Book2's level and the plant's spindle [t/h] | the lowest level 322F001 holds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 92.3 % (P1b) | 58.9 | 25.9 at 7.05 % | 6.6 at 63 % | about 16 % |
| 111 % (P1) | 65.7 | 56.9 at 10.8 % | 23.0 at 76 % | about 12.5 % |

The plant holds those levels with its spindle at 63 and 76 %. So the runner cannot settle Book2's level
by any initialisation or gain: the suction law, on the back-solved geometry of data gap 1, would have
to change. Session 82's solve stalled at 21-25 % because its capacity ceiling (2.5 times design) was
reached. Raised to 8, the spindle closes toward its floor and the sump falls toward its lowest
holdable level.

**322E001 does not turn down.** 322E001's bottoms in the P1b hold (f held at 1), term by term:

    T_bot = T_bot,des + 0.7 dT_steam + dT_bot + dT_strip
          = 172.0 - 0.86 + 5.82 + 0 = 176.97 C        (logged 176.70; the plant 166.6)

* dT_steam is -1.22 K: PIC-329204 at Book2's 19.22 bar a.
* dT_bot is V1's feed-deficit rise, dT_load = cap (1 - exp(-raw / cap)), with raw =
  dT_steam,des (m_des / m - 1) = 6.30 K. The stripper's liquid feed is 0.965 of design at 92.3 % CO2.
* dT_strip is 0: the gas-liquid excess r_gl = -0.043 is below design.
* At 111 % the flood branch sets dT_bot at about +7.7 K, so the bottoms read 179.4 C (the plant 172.25).
* Book2's TT-322004 falls 1.26 K per K of the steam's saturation from 111 to 92.3 %; V1's slope is 0.7.

Against the verified RC100 hold at 100 % — which ran its own scheduled PIC-329204 and LP master (4.96 against

over the design's, on a capacity anchored at exactly the design demand. The prototype C1 lifts a capacity
below 1 by the shell's margin M, to at most 1: rho' = min(rho . M, max(rho, 1)). M = 1.75 fits Book2's

it moves five results by about 1e-6 (the seed's capacity is 0.9999988). The records disagree on the
circulation: the plant's ~320 t/h at 28.8 K is about 10.7 MW, above Uhde's 8 000 kW. The engine runs

# Part XCVII — The start-up intro, and the plant held until 100% LOAD

Session 84 (2026-11-04). **No equation is ported, altered or found to disagree with V1.** The intro
computes no process quantity: its formulas are the easing curves in `ureasim/hmi/intro/timeline.py` and
the look-at projection in `ureasim/hmi/intro/camera.py`, and it reads no engine value. Nothing below
`ureasim/hmi` changed except `run.py`'s construction of the engine.

## XCVII.1 What starts the plant (decision 166)

| | before | now |
|---|---|---|
| `python run.py` | engine built and running from the start | engine built **held** (`EngineSession.frozen = True`, set in `run._serve` before the physics thread starts); the intro plays |
| the plant clock | steps from the first pass | does not move until the release; `advance` returns 0 steps while frozen, so no owed time builds and nothing bursts at the release |
| the console packet | published every 0.1 s | not published until the first tick (`packet()` is empty before it) |
| 100% LOAD pressed | | the console is built hidden, the bridge connects, `{"type": "freeze", "on": false}` goes out, the first packet ends the wait |
| `python run.py --no-intro` | | as before: not held |

The release is the engine's existing `freeze` command (`engine/session.py` `_simulator_command`), `on`
stated because a missing `on` toggles. The held seed is the design seed, the 1750 MTPD design basis, which
is the 100 % load; the intro's `load_100` key therefore maps to the release and to nothing else
(`data/intro.py` `START_COMMANDS`, pinned by `tests/hmi/test_startup.py` to a command in
`SIMULATOR_COMMANDS` with `on` False).

## XCVII.2 What was measured

* Press at 1.7 s; console built 0.4 s; connected 0.4 s later; first packet about 6 s; shown 6.7 s.
* The first tick after the release is cold: 2.3 s on its own (`EngineSession()` itself 0.03 s). The
  bridge's watchdog is `STALE_MS = 5000` from the connect.
* One intro frame: `build_frame` 6.5 ms, a full repaint 46 ms at 125 % display scaling (session 84; the figures after session 85 are in XCVII.3).

Tolerance: none applies, nothing is compared with V1. The held plant and the running plant are the same
engine; `tests/test_run.py` asserts that a held plant publishes nothing, that the start command releases
it with an accepted ack and live packets and a status of ENGINE RUNNING, and that a plant not held runs
from the start.

## XCVII.3 The intro's frame cost (handoff A-25 point 1, session 85)

Measured on the development machine, the real `IntroSplash` at 125 % display scaling (1366 x 720 logical, 1708 x 900
device pixels), `paintEvent` timed from the live 16 ms timer over 10 s, and a synchronous `repaint()` over 300 frames.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| hold (orbit idle), `repaint()` | 46.8 ms (21 fps) | 16.2 ms |
| hold, live timer | not measured | paintEvent median 15.0 to 15.1 ms (95th percentile 18.1 to 18.5 ms), delivered 60.3, 60.5 and 60.7 fps over three 10 s runs on an idle machine (57 to 59 fps while a background job loaded it) |
| scan (first 3.7 s), live timer | not measured | paintEvent median 11.1 ms, 62.9 fps delivered, worst frame 16.4 ms |
| fullscreen hold (1536 x 960 logical) | not measured | paintEvent median 17.5 ms, 52.2 fps delivered, 10 frames over 25 ms in 10 s |
| `build_frame` | 7.5 ms | 2.4 ms |
| first text drawn in the process | 0.6 s stall in the animation | before the window shows |

Cuts, in order of payoff (one run each at the hold, noise about 1.5 ms): paper bitmap, flat caps and cached fonts,
46.8 to 26.4; numpy wires, to 19.5; hairline thin wires, to 17.1; the paper cached by identity and the fade evaluated
only near a zone, to 16.4; a pooled QLineF list, to about 15.4.

**Exactness.** The numpy `_wires` does elementwise arithmetic in the scalar code's order (no matrix product), floors
`v + 0.5` for the opacity level and sorts stably, so every operation is the scalar version's, to the last bit; the
scalar version stays in `tests/hmi/intro/test_intro_flyby.py` as the reference. `camera.transform_array` equals
`transform_all`. A baked paper equals the directly drawn one pixel for pixel at six sizes and pixel ratios
(`test_intro_painter.py`). The hairline rule keeps the ink of a thin wire to 3.7 % at 125 % scaling (1 % at 100 %).
Nothing here touches a process quantity.

**Rejected, with the measurement:** antialiasing off for the thin wires saved 3.6 ms and left the vessels visibly
jagged; `max_segment` up to 60 removes at most 21 % of the edges (1,988 to 1,563) with no measurable change in cost
(the rings are 12-sided); one stroked `QPainterPath` per batch gave no gain over `drawLines`; a cosmetic pen saved
2 ms but its width does not follow the window; `QStaticText` saved 0.5 ms but 1,148 bytes of the frame differ from
`drawText`; baking the logo and titles changes the text weight (Qt blends antialiased text onto an opaque target and
onto a transparent bitmap differently, up to 76 in 255), so only the opaque paper is baked. Session 87 closed A-26 with a GPU canvas
(Part XCIX.1), after measuring the fixed-stage layer and the threaded raster and rejecting both.

## XCVII.4 The first packet and the staleness watchdog (point 2)

The bridge's watchdog was 5 s from the connect. An engine held at its design seed publishes nothing until released and
its first tick is cold (2.3 s), leaving about 1 s of margin. `EngineBridge._arm_stale` now arms `FIRST_PACKET_STALE_MS`
= 30 s until a packet with content has arrived, then `STALE_MS` = 5 s for the bridge's life, reconnects included. The
start-up controller's wait is 45 s (`STARTUP.packet_timeout_s`), so the bridge's watchdog speaks first. The thermo memo
is not warmed.

Checked at the real constants, with the real engine and bridge (session 85, a scripted run): a held engine and an
`EngineBridge`, 7 s with no packet (the strict window would have fired at 5 s) -- still connected, no `DISCONNECTED`, the
watchdog armed at 30 000 ms; after the release the first live packet came 2.7 s later and the watchdog read 5 000 ms. And
`run._run_with_intro` driven by script (skip, press, wait): the console shown 3.3 s after the press, its packet live
(health ok, heartbeat 14), no bridge blank during start-up (the one blank in the log is 0.5 s after the console showed,
when the script closed the application). The unit tests pin the same logic at 60 and 600 ms so they do not wait.

## XCVII.5 Section order (point 3)

`data/intro.SECTIONS` is 321 NH3 PUMPING, 322 UREA SYNTHESIS, 329 STEAM & UTILITIES, 323 LP RECIRCULATION, 328
DESORPTION, 324 EVAPORATION, the order the console's tab bar first reaches them (`screen_layout.SCREENS`:
321-1, 322-2, 322-1, 329-1, 323-1, 323-2, 328-1, 328-2, 324-1, 324-1b). A test derives the order from that list.

## XCVII.6 The flyby's drawing choices, signed off (point 4)

Signed off as built by the process engineer, 2026-11-04: the HP-loop wireframe is a stylized splash and not an
operator training mimic. 322D001 is drawn once (project.md lists A and B); 322F001 is drawn once at the junction and
HV-322602 is not drawn; unlabelled valves and every instrument are omitted; 322R001's liquid outlet is drawn at the
bottom nozzle. The layout is a design choice, not to scale, and the screen says so.

## XCVII.7 The logo asset (point 5)

`hfc-logo.png` is 1280 x 602, 8-bit RGBA (colour type 6): the supplied 640 x 301 mark (md5
f66903d8fa9929a07314077ef0ea35bc) resampled exactly 2x on premultiplied alpha with Lanczos, each output pixel then
clamped to the range of its 3 x 3 source neighbourhood. Lanczos alone overshot that range by up to 46 in 255, bicubic
by up to 29, bilinear by none; the clamp removes the ringing and the halo. The regions in `data/intro.LOGO` are the
supplied file's, doubled. A resample adds no detail, and none shows: drawn the way the intro draws it, the old and the
new file give the same picture at 125 % and at 100 % (mean gradient energy of the Arabic name +2.4 % and +1.9 %, of the HFC
letters' edge -1.4 % and +1.4 %, 4x crops compared by eye), so this is not a sharpening. What it buys is that full-screen
playback never scales the source up: the mark is drawn 480 design pixels wide, which is 675 device pixels on a 1920 x 1200
screen, more than the old file's 640 and about half the new one's 1280. A vector mark from HFC would be the real sharpening.
`SmoothPixmapTransform` is on for every operation of `IntroPainter.paint` (pinned by a test).

is not in the tree (removed per his notes) and was not recreated. Nine deliberate breaks of the new behaviour were

## XCVIII.1 B-124: 322R001's fill, and the cold start re-baselined (decision 168)

**LT-322504 is a narrow band.** It maps the 1.5 m band whose top tap stands 1.0 m above the overflow line
(UD-AU-322-EC-0006 p6 and p14, `data/unit_322r001.py`). In the engine's frame the funnel's lip, 19.3 m,
reads 33.3 %, and free overflow at the design flow reads about 36.5 % (a Francis head of 0.048 m). So
36 % is a full reactor overflowing at its funnel. 100 % is the funnel backed up 1.0 m above its lip,
with more liquor arriving than HV-322605 passes at its stroke.

**The probe.** The Phase 7 cold start, port side, ran to 10 000 s with the switches below
(`s84/cs84.py`; `s82/p7_switch82.py` on HEAD; a scratch worktree for 0313003, its stores' keys matched).

| run | engine | reaches the lip (33 %) | 99 % or more | peak | LT-322504 at 8 000 s | at 10 000 s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R0 | 0313003 (session 52's engine) | 6 420 s | 7 830 s | 100.0 % at 8 070 s | 100.0 % | 59.5 % |
| T4 (Session 83) | HEAD, low-N/C branch off | 6 420 s | never | 69.0 % at 9 480 s | 36.3 % | 61.3 % |
| P1 | HEAD, branch off, B-103 and B-104 off | 6 420 s | never | 74.6 % at 8 670 s | 46.7 % | 53.3 % |
| P2 | HEAD, branch off, V1's 2 600-tube bundle | 6 390 s | never | 42.2 % at 9 990 s, still rising | 36.1 % | 42.2 % |
| P3 | HEAD, branch off, B-103 and B-104 off, V1's bundle | 6 390 s | never | 65.9 % at 9 750 s | 36.5 % | 62.7 % |

* **Session 52's "full at 8 000 s" was the band's top.** 0313003 reads 100 % at 8 000 s and 59.5 % at
  10 000 s. Session 83 read the branch-off run's 36 % as "never full". The reactor was in fact full,
  overflowing at its lip from 6 420 s, the same time as 0313003's.
* **What differs is the backup above the lip.** In 0313003 the funnel backs up from 6 900 s, as soon as
  322E001's sump reaches 100 %. More liquor then reaches 322R001 than HV-322605 passes at its design 60 %,
  and LT-322504 climbs to the band's top by 7 830 s. On HEAD, with the branch off, the reactor stays at
  its lip until 322E001's sump drains, then rises to 69 % at 9 480 s.
* **B-103 and B-104 are not the cause.** 0313003's 322E001 sump clamps at 100 % (V1's clamp) and its
  discharge through HV-322605 carries no cap. `hold_full` and `tube_ceiling` off on HEAD (P1) give
  exactly that, and the peak rises only from 69.0 to 74.6 %.
* **f21f058's bundle is not the cause either.** On V1's 2 600-tube bundle the peak is 42.2 % (P2) and,
  with B-103 and B-104 also off, 65.9 % (P3).
* **The change is inside 15e66c2, and every harness switch off restores it.** Run to 9 000 s with the
  branch off where it exists:
  - 36fe38c backs up to 97.6 % at 8 010 s, as 0313003 does;
  - 15e66c2, 2e4d64c, f21f058 and ad75349 stay at the lip at 8 000 s (36.1-36.4 %), rising to
    51.8-53.0 % by 9 000 s on the last two;
  - HEAD with every harness switch off and V1's bundle (P4) backs up to 97.5 % at 8 010 s.

  So one or more of 15e66c2's switched decisions holds the reactor at its lip:
  - 322E001's shell bound (139);
  - its tubes standing full (140, with B-103);
  - 323D001's liquor into 322E003 with 323E003's species (141, 146);
  - 322R001's design drop and flash cap (148, 145).

  Three probes on HEAD split them (to 8 500 s, the branch off):
  - 322E001's shell bound off (decision 139): LT-322504 peaks at 91.2 % at 7 740 s, 88.4 % at 8 000 s;
  - the wash line and 323E003's species off: 36.0 % at 8 000 s;
  - 322R001's design drop and flash cap off: 36.3 % at 8 000 s.

  **The change is decision 139.** 322E001's duty bounded by its shell's LMTD (B-102, session 63)
  keeps the reactor at its lip during the fill. B-103/B-104 add a few points of the rest (P4 97.5 %).
  Decision 168 accepts the start as built, decision 139 included.

**Decision 166.** The process engineer approved option (a). 322E002's low-N/C branch (decisions 142 and
147) stays as built, and the Phase 7 cold start's record is re-baselined on the committed engine
(unchanged since 7a8fa3a; Session 81's port record, `p7/base`):

* trip 22.1 at 107.9 s;
* PT-329201 111.5 bar a at 2 000 s and 150.7 at 3 000 s, peaking at 154.7 bar a at 3 300 s;
* trip 22.2 at 3 322 s, with 21.2, 21.8 and 21.10 at 3 322.1 s. It cuts the CO2 and both ammonia pumps,
  and the loop falls to 79.7 bar a by 16 000 s;
* LT-322504 at 0 % throughout, since the trip comes before the reactor reaches its lip, and LT-329501 at
  100 % from 600 s.

Its fit, tau 540 s, dead time 540 s and final 78.61 bar g, is of a tripped trajectory and is not a
start-up answer. On record with it:

* Session 82's bisect to 15e66c2 and the branch-off switch (§XCV.2);
* the branch off to 16 000 s: no trip 22.2, tau 1 350 s, dead time 540 s, final 137.45 bar g (§XCVI.1),
  the reactor at its lip from 6 420 s;
* the SOP's filling ratio with the branch on: trip 22.2 at 5 863 s;
* the fill probe above.

The trip 22.2 scenario keeps decision 110's answer: 22.2 is not reached in 48 000 s (§XCIV.6). No test
pins decision 110's cold start (`tests/` searched), and no relation changes. B-124 is closed and deleted
from `handoff.md`.

## XCVIII.2 FT-329403 at the design point

The request compared FT-329403 at 100 % with "PFD stream 902's 57.99 t/h and 914's 66.90 t/h".
CLAUDE.md §4's two searches were made, `References\` first and then the vendor archive.

* **Where FT-329403 stands.**
  - `References\329-1 mapping and description.md` puts FT-329403, with TT-329101 and PT-329251, on
    material-balance stream 901 from 320E006, before it divides into 902 (PV-329204 to 329D005), 903
    (PV-329205A to 329D009), 963 (PV-329207C and HV-329602 to 322D001A/B) and 911 (328C003).
  - Uhde's loop summary F 329403 (UD-MR-329-EC-0001 rev 1, 04.06.07, page 15; a scan, read off the page
    image) gives the service as "STMH to 329D005 MP Steam Satur.", on line 300-STMH2-320501-BA13E-W 130
    (DN 300): an orifice plate FE 329403 with a dP transmitter, mass flow, normal 60.8 t/h (35 to
    81.0 t/h, range 0-85 t/h), 22.3 bar a and 330.0 C. Its normal flow is PFD 901's 60 848 kg/h at 901's
    330 C, not 902's 57 989 kg/h at 328 C.
* **What the engine publishes.** `engine/packet/steam.py` publishes FT-329403 as stream 901, the sum
  911 + 902 + 903 + 963. On the design seed (one tick, `s84/seed84.py`) it reads 60.850 t/h: 902
  57.989, 903 1.754, 911 1.105 and 963 0. That is PFD 901 to the kilogram and the loop summary's 60.8.
* **The two figures in the request.**
  - 902 is PV-329204's steam into 329D005, 57.99 t/h at the design seed (`STEAM_SYSTEM.MP.m_supply_th`).
  - PFD 26's stream 914 is condensate, 49 993 kg/h at 147 C and 4.4 bar a (55 011 kg/h in the 1925 MTPD
    case). The 66.90 t/h is the engine's `STRIP_DES_KGH`, 66 902 kg/h: 902 plus the 8 913 kg/h of
    329D005's water that 902's superheat boils (decisions 54 and 58), which 322E001's shell condenses.
    It is not a PFD stream, and the tag rules over the label.
* **The plant.** Book2's FY-329403 reads 53.45 t/h at 92 % (52.09-55.08), 59.93 at about 102 %
  (56.98-60.63, n = 34) and 66.26 at 111 % (65.70-66.96). The 1925 MTPD PFD (110 %) gives 901 66.80 t/h.
  So the plant's FT-329403 follows the PFD's 901 within 1-4 % at both cases.
* **The engine off design.** On Book2's set points the engine's FT-329403 read 63.00 t/h at 92.3 %
  (S2, 902 60.70) and 75.67 at 111 % (C1, 902 73.30) in Session 83. At 92.3 % that is above its own
  100 % value of 60.85; at 111 % it is 13 % above the 1925 MTPD case. Those holds ran on Book2's
  PIC-329204. With PIC-329204 trimmed 1-2 bar lower to hold TT-322004 (§XCVIII.3), the engine's
  FT-329403 reads 54.8-55.2 t/h at 92.3 % and 68.9-72.1 at 111 %, near the plant's. So the excess is the
  engine's stripper steam at the plant's shell pressure, not the meter's stream.

## XCVIII.3 B-118 and B-120 under active closed-loop trims

(`s84/opt_run84.py`, generated from Session 83's runner by `s84/mk84.py`; arms in `s84/cfg84.py`) runs
the committed engine at the fixed 0.1 s step through its own command handlers. Each arm starts from the
design seed, ramps the CO2 demand at 0.5 %/min, settles 3 h and holds 2 h, with every trim live through
the hold (`hold_mode` "trim_all"). The loops are velocity-form PIs stepped every 10 s:

**At 111 %:**
