to 45 % from five seconds after the seed; on every tick N, C, H and O are closed across each unit's call. Worst
residual over the 600 ticks, kmol/h of any element:

| 322E002: feed to gas and liquid | 7.3e-12 |

The two named exceptions, asserted as what they are:

* **B-127.** The reactor's feed less its corrected feed is `REACT_TEAR_DES_KMOLH` times the CO2 load ratio,

322E001's sump, 322E002's holdup and 322E003's sump are mass-only holdups of B-126's class: each passes on the
composition of the tick it was filled on (322E003's `y_overflow` is its last overflow's mass fractions,
`scrubber_sump.py:158`). They lie outside the units' calls the test closes; no new item was raised for them. A-34's
turndown test waits on B-118 and is one of its acceptance tests.

## CX.3 Wave 1, A-37: the bracketed root's exhaustions counted (decision 184)

`core.numeric.ROOT_LEDGER` counts each `bracketed_root` solve that runs out of its iterations with the bracket still
wider than `tol`; the root returned is the bracket's midpoint as before, so no result changes. The engine session
publishes the count since it began as `_health.roots_exhausted`. A residual with a step (1e6 above x = 0.5, -1 below)
holds the bracket open through all 80 iterations and is counted once; a smooth residual is not. Measured on the
plant: 0 at the seed over 60 s, and 0 through 300 s of the CO2 cut of CX.1. The thermo node stores hash only `thermo`
sources, so they stay valid.

## CX.4 Wave 1, B-132: one form of F_F for each valve

Walked on the tree (`tests/control/test_valve.py`, six tests): every liquid valve the engine runs calls
`valve_liquid_anchored`, nine calls in seven modules (`first_desorber`, `hydrolyser`, `second_desorber`,
`flash_tank`, `rectifying_column`, `steam_valves` three, `stripper_sump`), whose design reference and live flow both
evaluate F_F = 0.96 - 0.28 sqrt(Pv / Pc) in the same `_phi_liquid`. Nothing outside `control/valve.py` calls the
flat-intercept pair (`valve_flow_liquid`, `cv_from_design_liquid`, `gravity_outflow_kgh`); only the equivalence
suite drives it against V1. The vendor catalogues (`valve_sizing`, `control_valves`, `_metso`, `_fisher`) take the
design stroke from the vendor's printed capacity ratio and compute no choke. No mismatch; no relation changed.

## CX.7 Wave 2: B-129, B-130 and B-131 built as decided divergences (decisions 185 to 187)

Each switch is a class attribute (`typing.ClassVar`), not a dataclass field, because the snapshot's compatibility
check compares every object's attribute names: an instance field would have made the six shipped exercises and every
instructor's saved exercise unloadable. All six shipped exercises load after the change.

* **B-129 (b), decision 185.** `carbamate_condenser_322e002(..., release_heat=True)`: the CO2 absorbed is no longer
  clamped at zero, so a net release costs its heat of formation, and wherever the term is negative the outlet is held
  at the shell's temperature, t_prod = max(t_prod, T_shell). `CondenserHoldup.release_heat`; False is V1's clamp, set
  in the equivalence harnesses. Measured on the unit at the design feeds, saturation fraction 0, shell 147.0 C: the gas
  carries 2 403.50 kmol/h of CO2 both ways; V1's duty 2 366.90 kW (the gas's sensible heat), outlet 147.33 C, 5 523.5 kW
  of steam; the rewrite's duty -20 704.31 kW, T_adb -10.5 C (one specific heat, `CP_GAS` 2.0), outlet 147.0 C, no
  steam. At saturation fractions 0.3 and 1 every field is the same both ways. `HPCC_STEAM`'s stream record follows the
  duty and reads negative in a net release; the steam the shell raises is `q_steam_kw`, floored at zero.
* **B-130 (b), decision 186.** `ProcessLoop.reseed_after_bad`: through a bad PV the history `pv1`, `pv2` is set
  non-finite (unknown; the snapshot encodes it), and the first good sample reseeds both to itself, so the loop acts on
  its integral alone on that tick. On a 2 bar move through a 5 s outage (Kc 2, Ti 60 s): the rewrite steps the output
  by the integral, -0.00667 %; V1 by -4.00667 %. The output stays frozen through the outage both ways; without a bad PV
  400 ticks are the same to the bit. V1's side on the switch in `test_process_loop_equivalence.py`.
* **B-131 (b), decision 187.** `BandedInterlock.nan_is_live` and `HystereticInterlock.nan_is_live`: a NaN or infinite
  PV is a live initiator, latches the trip and blocks its reset (22.2 and 22.1). V1 reads a NaN and -inf as healthy and
  +inf as tripping. Over 22.2's finite excursion both sides are the same.

**The seed.** The plain seed at session 98's commit (`6853ac3`) against the tree with Waves 1 and 2, 18 000 ticks,
every tick of the first 20 and every 10 s: 200 samples of all 3 694 packet leaves (`STREAMS` included), none differs.

**The suite.** 2 190 passed, 5 862 skipped (`E:` not mounted), 1 failed:
`test_console_while_frozen.py::test_a_reset_and_a_restored_exercise_keep_a_frozen_console_live_past_the_watchdog`,
whose last assertion read the console's engine label as still FROZEN after the released plant's clock had moved. The
suite ran beside two 45-minute engine runs of Wave 3; alone the file passed three times of three (36 s, 33 s, 33 s),
and Wave 1's suite passed it. A timing race under load, not a change of behaviour; nothing in the console or the
server was touched.

## CXI.2 The control's ramp, read again (bundle A, 74.4 %, the tree with Waves 1 and 2)

pressure the K_N line adds above the design melt. The deficit is (P_bub - P_loop) - 3.5 bar.

* **The ratio never reached its floor at the plant.** The set point sits on 2.0000 to 2.0012 from 900 to 1 680 s;
  the PV there is 2.021 to 2.028, and over the whole descent it runs 0.30 to 1.46 % above its set point (mean
  1.03 %), the ammonia lagging the CO2's ramp. Its minimum is 2.0210 at 1 260 s, 0.1 % under the design's 2.0231.
  The floor that bound is also the scratch operator's own limit (`opt_run95.py:230`, lo 2.0). The plant's ratio
  is flat with load, 2.047 to 2.053 on the engine's basis in every band (§XCIII.3): it uses none of its downward
  authority on a turndown.
* **The hump is the K_N line.** The melt N/C rises from the first minute to 3.647 at 960 s with the fresh ratio
  0.1 to 0.8 % over the design, worth about 0.01 to 0.08 of AT-322701 at §XCIII.3's sensitivity (0.14 for 1.43 %
  of ratio). In 45 of the 46 samples to 2 760 s the deficit is positive, and in 36 of them K_N's term alone is
  the whole deficit or more (0.05 to 1.58 of it). With Extended UNIQUAC's 1.3 bar per unit of N/C (§CX.8) in
  K_N's place and nothing else changed, the deficit on those samples is positive in 9, at most 1.86 bar at
  2 760 s, the loop pressure's fall [I: a static reading; the trajectory would differ].
* **A feedback on the high side** [I]: N/C up, the K_N line raises the bubble pressure, the fraction falls, the
  uncondensed gas returns through 322R001, 322E003 and 322F001, and the melt N/C rises further.
* **The downswing starts at a ratio at or above the design.** AT-322701 falls under 3.00 at 2 520 s, the set
  point 2.0117 (the scratch operator still winding back from the hump) and the PV 2.029. 322R001's off-gas
  rises from 22.6 t/h at 60 s to 33.3 at 1 320 s and 49.4 at 2 760 s while the load falls 23 %, and 322E003's
  make from 57.8 to 80.8 t/h, before the melt crosses 3.0 at 2 815 s. Which boundary stream carries the loop
  from AT 3.42 to 2.85 at that ratio is not measured: no run logs the loop's N and C boundary.
* E0 reads the same: melt N/C 3.654 at 960 s, the PV's minimum 2.0220, K_N's term the whole deficit or more in
  36 of 44 samples.

## CXI.3 What follows

* **B-128 is not what failed E0.** §CX.8's "with the floor binding, a different target cannot move the ratio"
  holds for the set point and not for the plant: the ammonia never fell to the floor, and the hump does not come
  from an excess of it. A lower floor lets the operator wind further back before the downswing [I]. B-128 stays
  a question of the faceplate, on the DCS readback checklist's row 15; its other side is one scratch arm, the
  floor at 1.9397 (2.0 x 2.0231 / 2.086) in the scratch operator's limit and in the command's clamp.
* **E1r is the experiment the runs point at, and it was not run.** E0's failure stopped the wave under the
  plan's own rule, and E1 had failed a seed criterion that a law with no margin at the seed cannot meet. The
  three faults are session 98's plan's: the stop at the first failed step, E0 placed before E1, and E1's
  criterion of every leaf identical.
* **E1's shape.** Session 99's fit keeps the K_N line above a ridge of 3.40 to 3.45; the hump reaches 3.65. The
  variant to measure takes Extended UNIQUAC's shape on both sides (decisions 142 and 147's source), the K_N
  line retired in the prototype: `BUB_KN` 0.18 is V1's calibration (`data/unit_322e002.py:152`), no document
  behind it. Its margin on Book2's five bands is 4.38 bar by §CX.8's fit, to be confirmed.
* **E1's seed criterion** is the process engineer's: the unit at the design feeds identical to the bit, the
  console's tags unchanged and every leaf within a stated relative tolerance (§CX.8 measured 820 leaves, the
  reactor's overflow CO2 by 1.1e-6); or a gate. A gate must bring about 4.4 bar in within the seed's own
  neighbourhood of N/C, a kink at the design point [I]: not recommended.
* **Session 95's table is stale** (decision 185, §CX.8): the five holds are run again on the tree before an
  arm is scored against them.
